newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds lose momentum, key prop at 109-12.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds lose momentum, key prop at 109-12.

text.p: June T-bond futures are beginning to lose momentum and may drift down to support at 108-30 in the next few days, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
But if the contract manages to hold above 109-12 on Tuesday, it could target 111-00 fairly quickly, they added.

"We're losing momentum and are beginning to get sell signals coming through, so support at 108-30 may prove to be the aim over the next day or so," said Elli Gifford, independent technical analyst near Cambridge.
Charts show the market hit a daily low of 108-30 on May 8, the lowest point so far this month.
By 0829 GMT, June T-bonds were down 3/32 at 109-26.
Gifford said intermediate support at the May 15 low of 109-12 was key.
"If that were to hold it would be reasonably positive and then we could go up to 111-00 pretty quickly," she said. "But right now I suspect that will be broken."
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said trendline support around 109-20,19 would likely hold, even though hourly stochastics remained weak.
They said in a note the 112-00 level was within reach medium term, but added a good deal of resistance in the low 111s meant building longer term shorts in that area made sense.
"Key support comes in at 108-30. A move below there would suggest that a top is in," they said.
They said they expected slightly higher prices through the middle part of the week.
By 0849 GMT, September Eurodollars were down 0.005 at 93.880.
